output.summary: The function computes a hash value using a simple linear hash function.

claims.text: The function iterates over each byte in the input buffer.
The loop increments the hash value by multiplying the current hash by 0x21 and adding the current byte.
The function returns the computed hash value as a 64-bit unsigned integer.
The function does not modify the input or output buffers.
